Doctoral Degrees in Computing, AI, and Cybersecurity
Nova Southeastern University's College of Computing, AI, and Cybersecurity offers
a transformative array of Ph.D. programs that blend the best of on-campus and online
learning. As a student in one of our Ph.D. programs, you will work closely with expert
faculty to conduct cutting-edge research in a variety of areas, including programming,
cybersecurity systems design, and database management.
Our Ph.D. programs are uniquely designed for working professionals, allowing you to
advance your education without putting your career on hold. With no residency requirements,
you can earn your Ph.D. from anywhere, seamlessly integrating your studies into your
busy schedule. This flexible approach empowers you to balance work, life, and doctoral
studies, providing a pathway to achieve your academic goals without disruption.
NSU's Ph.D. programs are designed to prepare students for leadership roles in academia,
government, and industry. You will gain the deep technical knowledge and cross-disciplinary
skills needed to succeed in the rapidly evolving digital era.
You will have the unique opportunity to conduct original research in a collaborative
and supportive environment. With our innovative faculty and NSA-recognized coursework,
NSU is the ideal place to pursue a Ph.D. in computing, AI, or cybersecurity. Gain
the NSU Edge. Explore our programs today.

Cybersecurity Designations
NSU's M.S. Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity program is validated by the NSA as a designated Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity
(AICyber) Program of Study, and the M.S. Cyber Defense and M.S. Cybersecurity Management programs are validated by the NSA as designated Cyber Defense (CD) Programs of Study.
NSU’s Ph.D. Computer Science, Ph.D. Cybersecurity Management, and Ph.D. Information Systems programs are validated by the NSA under the CAE-R designation.
